title: `origins = ["*"]` with `credentials = true` is refused at boot and at runtime alike, and so is `same_site = "None"` without `secure`
divergesFromPhp: `header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *')` beside `Allow-Credentials: true` is accepted by PHP and silently rejected by every browser; here the pair does not boot and `Core\Config::set` will not form it
